scope: Local common-panel simulator runs only. A new run receives a new environment fingerprint and is never merged under a historical package-lock hash.

cudaq.runtime_library_policy: Set CUDA_PATH and prepend the selected environment's site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH in the execution wrapper.
smokes: CUDA-Q tensornet-mps tiny state and dense-reference overlap

cutensornet.runtime_library_policy: Use tracks/cutensornet/code/with_cutensornet_env.sh with CUTENSORNET_PYTHON set to the fresh environment.
smokes: cuTensorNet tiny Network contract_path plus contract
CircuitToEinsum conversion of a panel QASM

immutability.rule: Do not mutate or delete historical environments. They are smoke-tested evidence and rollback references only.

prohibitions: Do not modify the system NVIDIA driver or toolkit.
Do not install unpinned latest CUDA-Q, CuPy or cuQuantum packages.
Do not reuse old timing values under a new environment fingerprint.
Do not start common-panel timing before adapter preflight and checkpoint pass.
